attributes.description:
Permits for commercial and nonresidential purposes.

Map Layers include below filtered data:

  • Nonresidential and Commercial Permits in Review
    • Permit Type: BB, BM
    • Subtype: Commercial, Nonresidential, Hotel, Office, Other, School
    • Permit Status: Open, Pending
  • Nonresidential and Commercial Permits Issued
    • Permit Type: BB, BM
    • Subtype: Commercial, Nonresidential, Hotel, Office, Other, School
    • Permit Status: Issued
  • Nonresidential and Commercial Permits Completed
    • Permit Type: BB, BM
    • Subtype: Commercial, Nonresidential, Hotel, Office, Other, School
    • Permit Status: Closed
  • Hotel Permits Issued
    • Permit Type: BB, BM
    • Subtype: Multifamily Residential
    • Permit Status: Issued
    • Hotel Motel Units Created: > 0
  • Hotel Permits Completed
    • Permit Type: BB, BM
    • Subtype: Multifamily Residential
    • Permit Status: Closed
    • Hotel Motel Units Created: > 0
  • All Tenant Improvements (Permit Issued or Project Completed)
    • Permit Type: BY, BZ
    • Permit Status: Issued, Closed

 

Note: The data shown in this map is updated daily. The unfiltered data source can be found by visiting the Bellevue Permit Data page

If you would like to have the complete dataset going back to 1998 please contact OpenData@bellevuewa.gov and request the complete Permit Data set.
